decisions.rationale: Keep the joint v0.1.0 release. Do not reopen product-only versus joint-release strategy now.
Re-run or confirm exact-head CI, inspect the lockfile-only diff, then merge before cutting release artifacts.
Use one bounded proof packet: desktop full page, above fold, 390×844 mobile, 30–60 second scroll video, checksums and exact commit.
Ship #304 immediately after release, then make #174 the dominant product lane.
Create four outcome milestones plus a research backlog: v0.1 Release, v0.2 Evidence Flagship, v0.3 Safe Activation, v0.4 Query & Distribution, Research/Later.
Freeze new permanent governance mechanisms for two product waves. Allow only fixes that remove a demonstrated repeated failure or replace an older mechanism.
Keep current language as a clearly labelled personal/legacy Story mode for v0.1; move new surfaces toward Work Shape or System Signature.
Export counts plus coverageRatio in [0,1] and a versioned coverageMethodId. Do not retain an ambiguous coverageScore.
Land one v1 robustness PR with no semantic reinterpretation, then publish a v2 ADR and implementation for gate semantics.
In v2 every gate carries a rule reference and supporting evidence; omit or mark not-applicable when evidence is absent. Never accept a free-floating verdict.
Use the preregistered 20% rule for the decision gate. Add a separately named descriptive any-reduction indicator only if a consumer needs it.
Use outcome-neutral non-promotion wording and derive threshold limitations from selection evidence rather than accepting them independently.
Own one executable TypeScript registry in Product and generate schema, registry docs and conformance fixtures from it.
Introduce a compile-time LensDefinition registry first. Consider external plugins only after several internally stable lenses expose a real common shape.
Use a strangler migration: freeze the legacy Story path except maintenance; route every new System/Research lens through V2; migrate old surfaces only when touched.
Product computes deterministic Kaplan–Meier, cumulative-incidence/risk tables and bootstrap uncertainty; Lab owns AFT/model sensitivity and exports reviewed findings later.

Use PRs created inside the explicit window; merged is the event, closed-unmerged a competing outcome, open at window end right-censored. Start with versioned provisional floors: 20 eligible, 10 merge events, 5 per group.
Canonicalize fixture-owned temporary roots before invoking the production boundary; retain strict production root identity until a separately reviewed security change.
Treat a per-launch bearer/CSRF-bound session token as a packaging gate for CLI/desktop, not a blocker for the current synthetic/source-run release.
Complete #174 on invented stores, then #201, then #202, then one owner-selected public metadata canary with deletion/replay proof.
Do not persist cross-repository C4 hashes by default. Use ephemeral per-analysis hashes or installation-keyed, purpose-scoped HMACs with explicit retention/deletion if the feature becomes necessary.
Default UI to age/coarse status, expose exact local timestamp in an inspection drawer, and keep public/exported projections at day/week grain or suppress entirely.
Keep remote telemetry disabled. Add structured local diagnostics and an explicit user-generated support bundle first.
After v0.2 value: make source-run excellent, ship a thin npm CLI and gh launcher, then measure setup friction before an Electron shell.
Keep Team mode aggregate-only with explicit audience, coverage and uncertainty. Treat every individual comparison as a separate owner/consent/research gate.
Pin an exact Taskdeck commit/schema in a local private integration config; keep public docs at compatibility-range level and require an activation card for writes.
Use exactly one owner-selected public repository, metadata-only, tiny request budget, no prose/person fields, short retention, explicit delete/replay drill, and no public derived output.
